description: Root schema for the video overlay processing task.

inputs.description: Input files and resources required for the video overlay process.

background_video_path.description: Path to the background video file.

overlay_zip_path.description: Path to the zip archive containing the images of the object to insert on top of the video.

output_zip_path.description: Path where the final output zip file will be saved.

config.description: Configuration settings for spatial positioning, transparency levels, and rendering behavior.

overlay_positions.description: Array of positioning, rotation, and transparency parameters for the overlay across frames.

background_transparency.description: Transparency level of the background video.

overlay_transparency.description: Transparency level of the inserted overlay object.

frames_per_image.description: Number of video frames each overlay image should be displayed on.

results.description: Execution output details including final status, timestamp, and error logs if any.

status.description: Current status of the execution (e.g., success, error).

error.description: Error description if the processing fails.

date_time.description: Timestamp indicating when the execution occurred in ISO 8601 format (UTC).
